_readme: Empty SYNC_TOKEN is filled on first apply and printed. Empty ADMIN_USER or ADMIN_PASSWORD turns /admin off. Both can also be changed on /admin. Empty SMTP_HOST turns mail off; the report is still stored. TZ is the shop clock and applies on the next start. REPORT_HOUR is 0-23. The page writes mail, the clock, the report hour, and the admin login back here.
